title: Feed monitor
subtitle: Health, posting statistics and auto-classification coverage for your feeds
error: Could not load the feed monitor
noFeedsDesc: Subscribe to feeds to see their health here.
tagCoverageCta: Create smart tags to see automatic classification here.
problemsDesc: Feeds that are failing to fetch or seem to have stopped publishing.
noProblemsDesc: No fetch problems detected on your subscriptions.
statsDesc: Posting cadence, weekday distribution and auto-classification per feed.
radarNoTags: No tags on this feed's posts yet — the web shows total posts per weekday.
radarHistory: Only {days} publishing day(s) of history so far — the web fills in as more weeks are collected.
noData: No stats yet — run a recompute after the first fetches.
autoClassifiedHint: {pct}% of this feed's recent posts were matched to your tags automatically (plus {manual} manually tagged).
untagged: not tagged by any smart tag
diagnosingHint: Searching the site and validating candidate feeds — this can take ~20s.

diag.MOVED_GONE: The address returns not found — the feed probably moved or died. We'll look for its new home.
diag.DNS_GONE: The domain no longer resolves. We'll search the web for the feed's new address.
diag.TIMEOUT: The server takes too long to answer. We'll check alternative addresses.
diag.CONNECT_FAIL: The connection fails before finishing. We'll look for alternative addresses.
diag.SSL_ERROR: The HTTPS certificate is invalid. We'll look for a working address.
diag.AUTH_REQUIRED: The server wants credentials (401/403). Free feeds shouldn't — let's look elsewhere.
diag.RATE_LIMITED: The server is rate-limiting us (429). We'll look for alternatives meanwhile.
diag.NOT_RSS: The address answers, but not with a feed. We'll search for the real one.
diag.UNKNOWN: Unclear failure. Collecting alternative addresses for you to compare.

noCandidates: No alternative RSS address found for this site.
noCandidatesHint: You can paste another URL from your notes and apply it directly.
tagCoverageDesc: For each of your tags: how many recent items were matched automatically vs manually assigned.
